name: witcher-hud
description: A compact Witcher 3 style HUD for Claude Code: a medallion that casts a sign for each tool, vitality for the context left, stamina for the rate limit, adrenaline for clean tool streaks, XP and levels for tokens, crowns for cost, and a quest tracker for the prompt at hand

language.title: Language
language.description: The HUD's language: en for English, ru for Russian (Русский)
